A steady town, filled with farmers and traders alike. The buildings are made of thick stone, the red tiled roofing on many of the buildings is strong and hearty. Much like the people of this humble and peaceful city.

Salsfirth is a location that can be found in the Grand Duchy of Trellin-Erdwise region.
